Players Committee card image of [[Scarif: Turbolift Complex]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' During your move phase, may move free between here and any related site. '''Dark Side:''' If you initiate a Force drain here, may rotate this site. Immune to Expand the Empire.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/scarifturboliftcomplex.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
